project.upload.uploadMode.group: 29    工程设置 › 上传设置    ·    project.upload
project.upload.uploadMode.note: 此组选择闲时、持续或定时上传。

project.upload.tip1.group: 29    工程设置 › 上传设置    ·    project.upload
project.upload.tip1.zh: 1、闲时上传，是指录播主机在无其他任务执行时，进行录像文件同步。
project.upload.tip1.en: 1. Idle: Upload recordings when the device is not running other tasks.
project.upload.tip1.original: 1. leisure, upload when no other tasks are executed.

project.upload.tip2.group: 29    工程设置 › 上传设置    ·    project.upload
project.upload.tip2.zh: 2、实时上传，是指只要有文件未同步完成，就会进行文件同步。
project.upload.tip2.en: 2. Continuous: Upload whenever files remain unsynchronized.
project.upload.tip2.original: 2. real time, upload as long as any file is not synchronized.
project.upload.tip2.note: 不承诺正在录制文件的实时码流上传。

project.upload.tip3.group: 29    工程设置 › 上传设置    ·    project.upload
project.upload.tip3.zh: 3、定时上传，是指在指定时间内进行文件同步。
project.upload.tip3.en: 3. Scheduled: Upload files during the specified time window.
project.upload.tip3.original: 3. timing, means that synchronize files within the specified time.
